WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        g.RegionCountryName,
        c.CustomerKey,
        c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName,
        sum(s.SalesAmount) AS TotalSpend
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s
    JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    JOIN retail.DimGeography g ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    GROUP BY g.RegionCountryName, c.CustomerKey, CustomerName
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        RegionCountryName,
        CustomerKey,
        CustomerName,
        TotalSpend,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY RegionCountryName ORDER BY TotalSpend DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
    RegionCountryName,
    rn AS Rank,
    CustomerKey,
    CustomerName,
    TotalSpend
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY RegionCountryName, rn
